description: Every TV Time feature, plus an offline watch-history mirror, bulk episode logging, and agenda/backlog/stats queries no TV Time tool has.

novel_features.name: stats
novel_features.description: Roll up your watched history into episodes, estimated hours, and your most-watched shows — straight from /user/{user_id}/stats.

novel_features.name: agenda
novel_features.description: See what airs today or in the next N days for the shows you follow.

novel_features.name: next
novel_features.description: Pick the single best next episode to watch across all your in-progress shows.

novel_features.name: backlog
novel_features.description: Rank the shows you follow by how many unwatched episodes are piling up.

novel_features.name: binge
novel_features.description: (stub) Bulk-mark a whole season or show as watched in one command. Not yet wired — requires a season-episode listing from a sync mirror that isn't implemented yet.

novel_features.name: since
novel_features.description: (stub) Show what changed in your queue since a point in time. Not yet wired — requires a local sync mirror with historical snapshots that isn't implemented yet.
